## Rebuild Notes

### Component Breakdown

```
<AdminLayout>
  <TopNavBar activeItem="admin" />
  <AdminSubNav activeTab="text-templates" />

  <PageContent>
    <PageHeader>
      <h1>My Text Templates</h1>
      <SearchInput placeholder="Search Templates" onChange={handleSearch} />
      <Button variant="primary" icon="plus" onClick={openCreateModal}>
        + Text Template
      </Button>
    </PageHeader>

    <FolderSection>
      <FolderHeader label="Hi Text Templates" count={0} collapsible />
      {/* count badge = 0 means this sub-folder is empty */}
    </FolderSection>

    <TextTemplateTable
      templates={templates}
      sortColumn="name"
      sortDirection="asc"
      onSort={handleSort}
    >
      <Column key="template" label="Template" sortable>
        {(row) => (
          <TemplateCell>
            <TemplateName>{row.name}</TemplateName>
            <TemplatePreview>{row.bodyPreview}</TemplatePreview>
          </TemplateCell>
        )}
      </Column>
      <Column key="score" label="Score" tooltip="AI-generated quality score">
        {(row) => <ScorePill status={row.scoreStatus} value={row.score} benchmark={row.scoreBenchmark} />}
      </Column>
      <Column key="replies" label="Replies" tooltip="Reply rate for this template">
        {(row) => <MetricCell current={row.replyRate} benchmark={row.replyRateBenchmark} />}
      </Column>
      <Column key="optouts" label="Opt Outs" tooltip="Opt-out rate for this template">
        {(row) => <MetricCell current={row.optOutRate} benchmark={row.optOutRateBenchmark} />}
      </Column>
      <Column key="sent" label="Sent" tooltip="Number of times sent">
        {(row) => <MetricCell current={row.sentCountUser} benchmark={row.sentCountTotal} />}
      </Column>
      <Column key="actions" label="Actions">
        {(row) => (
          <ActionCell>
            <IconButton icon="pencil" onClick={() => editTemplate(row.id)} title="Edit" />
            <IconButton icon="trash" onClick={() => confirmDelete(row.id)} title="Delete" variant="danger" />
          </ActionCell>
        )}
      </Column>
    </TextTemplateTable>

    <FloatingHelpButton />
  </PageContent>
</AdminLayout>
```

### MetricCell Component Logic
```tsx
// Format: "– (22%)" or "0 (32)"
// currentValue: null → "–", number → formatted value
// benchmarkValue: null → "–", number → formatted with parens
<MetricCell
  current={null}           // renders as "–"
  benchmark={0.22}         // renders as "(22%)"
  // combined display: "– (22%)"
/>

<MetricCell
  current={0}             // renders as "0"
  benchmark={83}          // renders as "(83)"
  // combined display: "0 (83)"
/>
```

### ScorePill Component
- When `status === "Pending"`: renders grey/muted "Pending (–)" badge
- When scored: renders a color-coded pill (green/yellow/red) with numeric or letter score + benchmark in parens

### Merge Tag Rendering (in template body)
- Template preview truncates the body to ~80–100 characters with "..."
- Merge fields are shown in their placeholder form in the preview (e.g., "Agent Name", "Contact First Name", "Inquiry Address")
- In actual template body editor, they would be displayed as colored chips or `{{variable}}` syntax

### Non-Obvious Logic
1. **Sent count format `0 (XX)`:** The `0` on the left may represent sends by the current logged-in user in the current period (all 0 because they haven't personally sent any), while `(XX)` is the aggregate total across the entire account history. This is important for multi-agent teams where templates are shared.
2. **"Pending (–)" Score:** FUB's AI scoring system requires a minimum number of sends before it generates a score. All templates here have 0 personal sends (left value), so scores remain Pending for this user — even if others have sent them.
3. **Benchmark values in parens:** The parenthetical values (e.g., `(22%)`) may represent the all-time average for that template across all users/sends — a benchmark the current user's rate would be compared against once they start sending.
4. **Folder URL structure:** `/2/text-templates/my/templates` — the `my` path segment indicates personal templates. A shared folder might be `/2/text-templates/shared/templates` or `/2/text-templates/{folderId}/templates`.
5. **Template naming convention at Ryan Realty:** Templates follow a `Category – Descriptive Name (qualifier)` pattern, e.g., `EXP-TO – Expired listing personal intro (manual send)`. The prefix codes (`EXP-TO`, `FSBO`, `Matt –`, `Paul –`, `Relistool –`) indicate lead type or broker attribution.
6. **No checkboxes for bulk delete/action:** Unlike some other FUB list views, this table does not appear to have bulk selection. Each template is managed individually.
7. **Search is client-side or fast AJAX:** The search input provides real-time filtering of the visible template list.
